````markdown
## Description

<big>Modifies the score (kill count) of one or more players. This action only has an effect in free-for-all modes.</big>

## Snippet

```
Modify Player Score(Event Player, 0);
```

## Properties

**Returns**: _<span style="color: #c678dd">Void</span>_
**Parameters**: ==_Player_==, ==_Score_==

> ==**Player**==
> _Type: **[Player](/wiki/articles/player)** | **Array** (**Player**), Default: **[Event Player](/wiki/articles/event+player)**_
> The player or players whose score will change.

> ==**Score**==
> _Type: **Integer**, Default: **[Number](/wiki/articles/number)**_
> The amount the score will increase or decrease. If positive, the score will increase. If negative, the score will decrease.
````
